label: PF Backlog 272
title: Imbibe EOS engineering principles into agent knowledge + role cards
body: Encode docs/ENGINEERING_OPERATING_STANDARD.md (general principles) into the product: bind the engineering knowledge layer (docs/guidelines/engineering/) to relevant agents in config/agent-capabilities.json, and add a shared Engineering-discipline block to .opencode/agent/*.md so every agent follows fail-closed/evidence/boundary/bounded-autonomy by default. See EOS section 12.
